items.title: Soil microbes accelerate carbon loss under repeated drought
items.hook: Repeated droughts turn soil microbes into carbon emitters
items.summary: Field plots that went through three droughts in a row released more carbon dioxide than plots that had one. The authors trace the change to microbes that switch to breaking down older soil carbon.

items.title: Observation of a light-induced phase transition in twisted bilayer graphene
items.hook: A flash of light flips twisted graphene into a new state of matter
items.summary: Two sheets of graphene stacked at a small twist angle switch into an insulating state when hit by a short laser pulse. The state lasts for nanoseconds and can be switched back with a second pulse.

items.title: Once-weekly oral GLP-1 agonist versus placebo in adults with obesity
items.hook: A weekly pill matched injections for weight loss in a large trial
items.summary: In a trial of 3,100 adults, a once-weekly pill led to an average weight loss of 14 percent over 68 weeks, compared with 2 percent on placebo. Side effects were mostly stomach upset early on.
